pdfplumber.name: pdfplumber (current FeeLens engine)
pdfplumber.role: Baseline: reads born-digital PDFs exactly; blind on scans and on text drawn as images.

tesseract.name: Tesseract 5
tesseract.role: Classic OCR already in the toolchain (via OCRmyPDF).

rapidocr.name: RapidOCR (PP-OCRv5 det + PP-OCRv6 rec, ONNX)
rapidocr.role: PaddleOCR models without the Paddle framework; ONNX Runtime on CPU.

doctr.name: docTR (DBNet ResNet-50 + PARSeq multilingual)
doctr.role: PyTorch OCR from Mindee with a multilingual recogniser.

florence2.name: Florence-2-large
florence2.role: Microsoft's small VLM; <OCR_WITH_REGION> gives text lines with boxes.

heron.name: Docling Layout Heron (RT-DETRv2)
heron.role: The layout model inside Docling: 17 classes (table, text, title, picture, key-value…).

ppdoclayout3.name: PP-DocLayoutV3
ppdoclayout3.role: PaddleOCR's layout model (25 classes incl. reading order), native in transformers.

doclayout_yolo.name: DocLayout-YOLO (DocStructBench)
doclayout_yolo.role: Fast YOLOv10 layout model. Weights Apache-2.0, but the doclayout_yolo package is AGPL-3.0 (Ultralytics fork): benchmark only.

tatr.name: Table Transformer (TATR) detection + structure v1.1
tatr.role: Microsoft's table models; rows and columns filled with PDF words (or Tesseract words on scans).

docling.name: Docling 2 (Heron + TableFormer accurate, Tesseract on bitmaps)
docling.role: IBM's converter: layout, TableFormer cell structure, reading order, markdown.

granite_docling.name: granite-docling-258M
granite_docling.role: IBM's tiny page-to-DocTags model: text, tables and boxes in one pass.

paddleocr_vl.name: PaddleOCR-VL 1.6 (+ PP-DocLayoutV3)
paddleocr_vl.role: Baidu's two-stage parser: layout boxes, then the VLM reads each crop (text or table).

glm_ocr.name: GLM-OCR
glm_ocr.role: Zhipu's OCR model, full page in one pass.

lighton_ocr.name: LightOnOCR-2-1B
lighton_ocr.role: LightOn's French OCR model, distilled for speed; strong on European languages.

got_ocr.name: GOT-OCR 2.0
got_ocr.role: StepFun's general OCR-2.0 model, format mode.

qwen3vl.name: Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct (fee prompt)
qwen3vl.kind: General VLM, direct fee extraction + grounding
qwen3vl.role: Asked directly for every fee figure with its box, as JSON. Shows the 'agent reads the page' route.

layoutlm_docqa.name: LayoutLM document QA (impira)
layoutlm_docqa.role: Extractive QA over Tesseract words: 8 fixed fee questions per page.

lighton3_08b.name: LightOnOCR-3-0.8B (grounding mode)
lighton3_08b.kind: End-to-end VLM (page to markdown with block boxes)
lighton3_08b.role: LightOn's 2026 OCR model on a Qwen3.5 base; the 'grounding' prompt returns every block with its box.

lighton3_1b.name: LightOnOCR-3-1B (grounding mode)
lighton3_1b.kind: End-to-end VLM (page to markdown with block boxes)
lighton3_1b.role: The Mistral-based sibling of the 0.8B model, same prompt.

xiaomi_ocr.name: Xiaomi-OCR-0
xiaomi_ocr.role: Xiaomi's document parser; tables come as OTSL grids, so cell structure is explicit.

minicpm_ocr.name: MiniCPM-OCR-1.0 (+ PP-DocLayoutV3)
minicpm_ocr.role: OpenBMB's OCR model used the official way: layout crops, then one prompt per element type.

mineru25.name: MinerU2.5-Pro-2605-1.2B
mineru25.role: OpenDataLab's parser: the same model first finds the layout, then reads each crop. Apache-2.0 (the older 2509 release is AGPL).

kosmos25.name: Kosmos-2.5
kosmos25.role: Microsoft's text-intensive image model; the <ocr> task gives each line with its box.

infinity_parser2.name: Infinity-Parser2-Flash
infinity_parser2.role: Asked for a JSON list of layout blocks (type, box, content); thinking turned off.

deepseek_ocr2.name: DeepSeek-OCR-2
deepseek_ocr2.role: DeepSeek's optical-compression OCR; the grounding prompt tags each block with its box.

heron101.name: Docling Layout Heron-101 (RT-DETRv2, ResNet-101)
heron101.role: The larger Heron variant: same 17 classes, deeper backbone.

egret_large.name: Docling Layout Egret-large (D-FINE)
egret_large.role: Docling's faster D-FINE layout family, large size.

egret_xlarge.name: Docling Layout Egret-xlarge (D-FINE)
egret_xlarge.role: Docling's D-FINE layout family, largest size.

slanet.name: SLANet+ (RapidTable) on PP-DocLayoutV3 table crops
slanet.role: PaddleOCR's light table-structure model via ONNX; RapidOCR reads the cells.

easyocr.name: EasyOCR (CRAFT + CRNN)
easyocr.role: Popular PyTorch OCR, run for comparison with RapidOCR and docTR.

hybrid_route.name: Hybrid: text layer or RapidOCR + Heron tables
hybrid_route.role: The cheap path every page takes: exact PDF text where it exists, OCR elsewhere, table rows rebuilt inside layout regions.

hybrid_vlm.name: Hybrid + PaddleOCR-VL on scans and table pages
hybrid_vlm.role: The cheap path, plus the vision model as a second reader only where it helps.

nemotron_parse.name: Nemotron-3.5-Parse
nemotron_parse.role: NVIDIA's page parser, single pass. Custom model code, reviewed before running (SC-5.13). Matches the best VLMs on the 8 hard pages but takes about 5 minutes per page on CPU.
